text:
Priya S.: thanks everyone for joining the all-hands! quick follow-up thread for any questions about remote/hybrid ops, travel, offsites, desk bookings, badge access. Jordan and Alex are here to help — drop Qs and we’ll reply throughout the day :wave:
Jordan M.: first q — what’s the lead time for booking the SF hub for a 2-day team offsite? any new policy on capacity limits?
Priya S.: good q. for SF hub please submit the Offsite Request form at https://confluence.redwood/ops/offsites. typical lead time is 2 weeks for small teams, 4+ weeks for 30+ people. capacity now capped at 60% for the next quarter due to renovations.
Maya T.: thanks — is there a preferred travel vendor for group flights?
Alex R.: we still recommend FlyRight for domestic, LookEast for APAC. for group itineraries open a ticket to travel@redwood and cc PeopleOps. use expense code `OFFSITE-TRAVEL-26` so finance tags costs correctly.
Samir K.: quick one: can ICs book a satellite office desk for a day (remote but visiting HQ) or is it restricted?
Jordan M.: you can reserve a desk up to 7 days in advance using the DeskBook app. daily visitors get hot-desk access. if you need a dedicated desk for >30 days, talk to your manager and file a desk request form.
Emma L.: is there any update on the travel reimbursement cap for international visas/expedited passports?
Priya S.: update: People Ops approved a one-time visa support of $350 for relocating contributors for product launches. expedited passport is still reimbursable up to $200 with pre-approval. please attach receipts to Concur and tag `relocation` or `offsite` accordingly.
Maya T.: will childcare/parental travel stipend be considered for offsites? wondering if we can get approval for nanny coverage days when traveling.
Priya S.: good ask — we’re piloting a childcare stipend for family travel for two offsites this year. details coming in next week’s followup doc; will include eligibility and reimbursement instructions.
Samir K.: badge access — my contractor’s badge expired last week; need same-day access for a 1-day visit. best route?
Jordan M.: facilities can generate a temporary visitor pass if you submit the visitor form before 10am. same-day after 10am requires manager approval + on-site sponsor. ping me with full name and date if you need help.
Alex R.: also FYI IT will ship loaner laptops for 5+ person offsites if requested. fill out the `device-shipping` short form. lead time ~72 hours.
Priya S.: re: travel approvals — managers should approve via Pulse before booking. if you need an exception (last-minute travel for customer escalation), mention `travel-exception` in the approval comments and People Ops will triage.
PeopleOps Bot: reminder: Offsite Request form auto-closes after submission. You will get an email with next steps within 48 hours.
Emma L.: thanks — will summarize and file a short FAQ. can someone confirm where the reimbursement policy doc lives?
Priya S.: linked here: https://confluence.redwood/ops/travel-reimbursement-policy. I’ll post a condensed FAQ in #announcements later today and attach the forms. :spiral_note_pad:
Maya T.: appreciate it. last tiny Q — is there a policy for remote-work stipends if someone moves to a coworking membership temporarily?
Priya S.: yes — coworking stipend remains $100/mo with manager approval; if it’s temporary for offsite month, request a prorated grant via People Ops.
Samir K.: perfect, thanks all. I’ll book the satellite desk for next Tue.
Priya S.: thanks everyone — leaving this thread up for the day. if you want something added to the FAQ DM me or drop here. we’ll capture action items and post a short follow-up doc by EOD. :memo:
